text:
SUPERIOR COURT OF CALIFORNIA, COUNTY OF LOS ANGELES
Jury Summons
Date: September 20, 2026
You are summoned to appear for jury service on November 2, 2026 at 8:00 a.m. Respond online at www.lacourt.org within 10 days. Failure to respond to this summons may result in a fine, and the court may issue a bench warrant. The court will never ask you for payment or your Social Security number by phone or email.
